fields.Damage: Weapon damage plus 2d4 Cold. A successful DC 12 Dexterity save negates the Cold damage.
fields.Attack bonus: Uses the firing weapon’s attack roll. No separate arrow bonus is listed.
fields.Surface: Ice in a 2 m (7 ft) radius for 2 turns. It is difficult terrain and creatures can fall Prone.
fields.Acquisition and encounters: Ranger starting gear. Sold by Arron, Cyrel, Barcus Wroot, Quartermaster Talli, and Roah Moonglow. Sometimes carried by ranged enemies.
fields.Crafting: The source lists acquisition methods but supplies no recipe.

fields.Category: Uncommon magical ammunition · single use · no attunement
fields.Activation: Fire as one attack using a compatible bow. Expend the arrow on hit or miss. No spell or extra action is required.
fields.Damage: On a hit, deal the bow’s normal damage. The target also takes 2d4 Cold unless it succeeds on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. No separate attack-roll bonus.
fields.Range: The firing bow’s normal range, capped at 60 feet.
fields.Radius and duration: On a hit, ground within 5 feet of the target becomes icy difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.
fields.Crafting: Draft recipe for one arrow: Arcana and Woodcarver’s Tools proficiency, one arrow, and 100 gp of frost-infused materials. Five 8-hour workdays using the 2024 uncommon consumable crafting guideline. The DM determines material availability.
fields.Encounter suggestion: An icy ravine lookout carries two arrows and uses them to slow pursuit across a narrow footbridge.
fields.History: Original tabletop adaptation of the ice ammunition used in Baldur’s Gate 3.

fields.Acquisition and encounters: The game-data index lists Sorcerous Sundries and Thunderhammer Smithy among its stockists.

fields.Damage: 1d6 missile plus 1d2 Cold. The extra damage has no save in the Shadows of Amn listing.

fields.Activation: Bonus Action to drink. Action to throw.
fields.Special powers: Grants Hastened for 3 turns. A thrown potion affects creatures in a 1 m (3 ft) radius. When the effect ends, the affected creature normally becomes Lethargic and misses its next turn.
fields.Crafting: Combine Ashes of Hyena Ear with any Salt using Alchemy.

fields.Special powers: While worn, Dexterity is at least 18 and attack rolls gain +1, including spell attacks.
fields.Acquisition and encounters: Sold by A’jak’nir Jeera in Crèche Y’llek.

fields.Use: Single-use ammunition fired as part of a ranged weapon attack.
fields.Compatibility: Arrow or bolt made for the launcher.
fields.Range: Use the launcher’s range unless the effect states otherwise.
fields.Effect: Fire at a sturdy anchor within the launcher’s normal range. The shot deals no damage. An attack roll that hits AC 13 secures a line for one Medium or smaller creature at a time.
fields.Creative use: Tie up a dangling gangway from across a gap.
fields.Conversion notes: Uses 2024 attack and saving throw conventions. Legacy range and attack penalties were omitted. The effect and any DC are part of this draft.

fields.History: Colin Davidson’s BECMI campaign list describes a large mounted siege crossbow.
fields.Legacy defense: AC 4 and 9 HP under BECMI conventions.
fields.Legacy crew and fire rate: Four crew members. The table lists one shot every two rounds.

fields.Encounter suggestion: Use a staffed ballista to cover an approach to a keep or a ship. Track loaded and aimed as two distinct states.
fields.Creative use: Have the crew prepare a shot while allies lure a large monster into the firing lane.
fields.Conversion notes: The 2024 stat block replaces the legacy defense, crew schedule, and firing cadence for tabletop play. Pricing retains the legacy catalog basis.

fields.Crafting: If the DM uses the 75 gp legacy price as the crafting basis, budget 37 gp in materials and 8 workdays for one proficient crafter. The DM assigns the required tools and workshop.
